how_given: In the Claude Code chat on 2026-10-19, answering finding #194 (an overdose written in the concern was not flagged when the case was created, on both devices): the question "Add an approved warning sign for overdose/poisoning to the reviewed checklist?" was answered "Approve RF20 (Recommended)", whose description read: Add "Took too much of a medicine, or swallowed something poisonous" at emergency level, measured on both devices and shipped in this release.

decision.name: RF20: overdose or poisoning
decision.what: add RF20 "Took too much of a medicine, or swallowed something poisonous" at the emergency level to the reviewed checklist, the A03 checklist and the red-flag screen
unchanged: the red-flag screen prompt red-flag-screen-1 (it lists the package's red flags, so it now includes RF20)

release_condition: Measured before release on both devices against the labelled set: written emergencies urgent at creation, false alarms on routine concerns, and the overdose case; the results are in measurement/ and are put to the reviewer.
